name: wavecenter
description: WaveCenter — the hub of the DEO movement, and the original DEO.

scripts.check:tasks-rls: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/check_tasks_rls.mjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/lib/*.test.mjs core/*.test.ts app/tasks/*.test.ts app/members/*.test.ts app/game/manage/*.test.ts app/auth/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:core-boundary && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check:browser-secrets
scripts.email:test: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/email_test.mjs
scripts.evolution: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/evolution_capture.mjs
scripts.evolution:tasks: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version -- node scripts/evolution_backfill_tasks.mjs
scripts.rate-tasks: doppler run --project wavecenter --config dev --no-check-version --only-secrets SUPABASE_URL,SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY -- node scripts/rate_tasks.mjs
